name: Trusted Demo (system override)
description: A framework proof, not a mod anyone plays: a TRUSTED in-process plugin that overrides game SYSTEMS rather than data. It freezes every monster by replacing the ported AI decision outright, registers a new effect, a new room builder, a new kind of monster attack, a shop rule and a new player command, and declares brand-new vocabulary the base game has no concept of - each through a capability-gated registry facade. Dev builds only; enable with ?trusted=demo-trusted.
author: neostryder
